snippet.title: Soul Riders Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Soul Riders is a multiplayer explor-racing game with an emphasis on chaotic fun drawing heavy inspiration from a certain cult classic game on a cube shaped console.
Players race around an open map in search of powerful, unique vehicles  - collecting upgrades and snatching power-ups to give them the edge in the final challenge.
From gliding as far as you can to leave your friends in the dust, or a good old destruction derby to beat some sense into them; the final challenge could be anything!
Be ready for mischief: your rivals can sabotage you by destroying your vehicle or swiping power ups.
Be on the look out for mysterious phenomena happening around town, they may just be what you need to come out on top!


Twitter: https://twitter.com/soulridersgame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/soulridersgame/
Website: https://www.soulridersgame.ca/
